title: [review] stack.rs: Integer overflow when casting routing header lengt
description: The expression `(routing_len / 8 - 1) as u8` overflows for routes with more than 127 intermediate hops. With remaining=128, the result is 256 which truncates to 0, corrupting the Hdr Ext Len field. While 127+ hops is rare, the code should either reject such routes or use checked arithmetic. The check at line 660-661 validates `remaining <= 255`, but should validate `remaining <= 127` to prevent this overflow.
